text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... I wonder which supermarket
I should go shopping at today."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, the shop in front of the station
has a huge sale on carrots.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, what should I do?
It might go on sale again sometime soon, after all...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll just keep it close by today.
Not really in the mood to move around much anyway...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin seems to have accumulated fatigue
from her races.
It might be best to review her race schedule.
